title: A deployment in another AWS organisation needs nothing from ours
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-e9e96f.

Remove default domains, the family footer registry and the default privacy link from core; make the monitoring stack and its seed scripts take the account from configuration; let Cyclotron support run in the deployment's own account.

comments.author: home
comments.text: From Humorus, 2026-11-11, first real attempt on a new account in another organisation: infra/pipeline/bootstrap.sh could not be used. Its default --repo is this repository, so step 4 would overwrite this repository's AWS_ACCOUNT_ID variable with the new account and redirect our own releases; with --repo set to the site's repository the roles trust a repository that has none of the workflows. stacks.json also names our own domain for the operators stack. Only the CDK bootstrap was run. Needed: a way to bootstrap a second account without touching this repository's variables, with the domain taken from configuration.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
From Humorus, 2026-11-11, Ryan's standing rule: nobody creates a cloud resource by hand; every resource is defined in Git and applied by a pipeline on merge, and agents use the AWS CLI to read only.

For this story that means `infra/pipeline/bootstrap.sh` should stop being a script a person runs per account and become a template a pipeline applies:
- The account's GitHub OIDC provider, the pipeline roles (today `papyrus-pipeline-approver.yaml` and `papyrus-stack-pipeline.yaml`) and the per-site deploy roles are CloudFormation (or CDK) stacks in Git, seeded into a new account from a template, with repository, domain and account taken from configuration. Nothing in it names AnthusAI/Papyrus, anth.us or our account variable.
- Where a stack must exist before any pipeline can (the very first role), the one-time person step is a single documented `aws cloudformation deploy` of the same template, not a bespoke script that writes repository variables.
- Hand-made roles, zones and providers in the running Anthus deployments are imported into those stacks (CloudFormation import with Retain), not replaced.
Humorus has drafted the full epic; it will be agreed with Ryan and the Papyrus session before it is filed here.
